wins: Collected initial network topology and service data rapidly, mapping open TCP ports 22, 80, and 443 within the first 4 steps.
Leveraged SSH banner information to confirm target OS version, enabling precise selection of subsequent service enumeration tools.
fails: Did not complete mission objective due to inability to escalate privileges on the target; every attempt terminated when the expected setuid binary was absent.
High dependency on mentor calls (15) indicates insufficient autonomous decision-making in later stages.
key_outcomes.summary: Recon reconnaissance was strong, but the run failed to reach exploitation due to repeated privilege escalation shortfalls and reliance on mentor guidance.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts always halted because the candidate setuid binaries (e.g., /usr/bin/passwd) were missing or had restrictive permissions, preventing exploit delivery.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner indicates OpenSSH 9.x
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted SSH enumeration with nmap ssh-brute and ssh-auth-methods scripts to capture valid login vectors.

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service returns extensive directory listing or identifies exposed .git directories
skill_cards.then_action: Invoke gobuster with tuned wordlists and focus on extracting config files/credentials, then record findings to memory.

skill_cards.if_condition: When web forms accept POST and return 200 with predictable cookies
skill_cards.then_action: Deploy OWASP ZAP active scan on the form to uncover injection points, logging results for subsequent exploitation attempts.

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in gathering SSH access vectors during reconnaissance.
Consistent discovery of sensitive web directories informed follow-up steps.

next_experiments.title: Privilege escalation audit
next_experiments.description: Map available binaries with sudo rights and fallback setuid paths, then test manually to confirm missing exploit targets before assuming escalation is impossible.

next_experiments.title: Credential brute-force refinement
next_experiments.description: Integrate Hydra with collected user lists from web forms and brute-force SSH/HTTP basic auth using bounded rate limits to reduce mentor intervention.

next_experiments.title: Automate follow-up after reconnaissance
next_experiments.description: Chain successful SSH and HTTP enumeration outputs into the automated exploitation pipeline to reduce manual mentor calls.
